optimization.name: real-erf
optimization.description: Replace the real-valued DERF1 wrapper around complex CERROR with standard intrinsic ERF(x); CERROR and all other source bytes remain unchanged
optimization.before:
real*8 function DERF1(x)
     real*8 x
     complex*16 zg,zgg 
!      y=DERF(x)
      zg=x
      call cerror(zg,zgg)
      DERF1=zgg
     return
     end
optimization.after:
real*8 function DERF1(x)
     real*8 x
      DERF1=ERF(x)
     return
     end
optimization.diff:
--- DERF1.original
+++ DERF1.real-erf
@@ -1,9 +1,5 @@
      real*8 function DERF1(x)
      real*8 x
-     complex*16 zg,zgg 
-!      y=DERF(x)
-      zg=x
-      call cerror(zg,zgg)
-      DERF1=zgg
+      DERF1=ERF(x)
      return
      end

source.output_instrumentation: Write every internal PDF point; remove duplicate first-point write; no arithmetic changes.

notes: Fortran method-1 scale quadrature, analytic A derivative and centered ubar derivative; the energy separation kernel is evaluated accurately rather than using the source's lookup approximation.
Contact probability remains the standard Persson A/A0; omitted probability is not contact.
Quadrature mass error is signed: resolved + unresolved - (1-A/A0). No density normalization, tail clipping or gap rescaling is applied.
Broadening and scale cutoffs can change the first moment relative to the energy mean gap.
Use analytic CDF differences for bin probabilities; pointwise trapz can miss narrow peaks.
Unresolved noncontact probability 0.026369119 is reported separately (scale cutoffs or boundary resolution); it is neither contact nor renormalized away.
